mapper.update: UPDATE media_file SET next_action_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'READY'
UPDATE media_file SET next_action_at = #{collectAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'READY'
UPDATE media_file SET status = 'DELETING', next_action_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE media_file SET next_action_at = #{next} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DELETING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM media_file WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DELETING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_reference WHERE file_id = #{id})
